changelog: # QuickView v6.59.2.1 Stable Release Notes We are excited to announce **QuickView v6.59.2.1 Stable**! This major feature and stability release introduces **Chromium-style Auto Pan**, a **streaming Highway SIMD pipeline for giant PNGs**, an **overhauled end-to-end HDR color & Gain Map pipeline**, **TinyEXR v3.4.0 with Win32 multithreading**, and critical stability fixes across **Titan huge-image switching**, **Explorer synchronization**, and **AI networking**. --- ### 📦 Installation & Updates * **Microsoft Store (Recommended)**: Click the badge above or visit [**Microsoft Store — QuickView (`9N1D85F032CC`)**](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N1D85F032CC), or run: ```powershell winget install 9N1D85F032CC ``` * **Scoop** *(#257)*: Now officially supported via the built-in manifest (`bucket/quickview.json`): ```powershell scoop install https://raw.githubusercontent.com/justnullname/QuickView/main/bucket/quickview.json ``` * **WinGet**: `winget install justnullname.QuickView` * **Installer / Portable**: Download `QuickView_Installer_v6.59.2.1_*.exe` or `QuickView_v6.59.2.1_*.zip` from the assets below. --- ### ✨ New Features & Performance * **[#309] Zero-Config Chromium Power-Law Auto Pan**: Replaced legacy linear speed sliders with a C¹-continuous axial-deadzone power-law curve supporting both **Click (Toggle)** and **Drag (Hold)** modes, driven by `DwmFlush()` VSync timing, Direct2D anchor visuals, and full Compare-pane / Minimap synchronization. * **[#311] Giant PNG Streaming Decoder**: Added lock-free SPSC ring decoding with streaming `zlib-ng` raw inflate and Google Highway SIMD PNG row unfiltering for fast, low-memory loading of huge non-interlaced PNGs. * **TinyEXR v3.4.0 & Core Dependencies Upgrade**: Upgraded TinyEXR to v3.4.0 with native Win32 thread pool synchronization (`SRWLOCK` / `CONDITION_VARIABLE`), alongside updated third-party decoders and ncnn Vulkan shader caches. * **Zero-Compromise Binary Slimming (-487 KB)**: Stripped unused TinyEXR ZSTD code (`EXR_NO_ZSTD`), dropped the legacy Skylake-X `HWY_AVX3` target while preserving `SSE4` / `AVX2` / `AVX3_ZEN4`, and moved pure-cold setup/config translation units to `/clang:-Oz`—reducing `QuickView.exe` by ~487 KB with zero hot-path degradation. --- ### 🎨 End-to-End HDR & Color Pipeline * **[#304, #306] Native HDR Decoding & Two-Stage Gamut / Highlight Mapping**: * Decodes PQ/HLG JXL as native 16-bit `EncodedHdr` codewords without forced 80-nit scaling and propagates true `PixelColorMetadata` + embedded ICC profiles across MasterWarmup, MasterBackingStore, LODCache, and `--decode-worker` IPC v2 (`SEC_RESERVE` up to 16 bpp). * Overhauled `ToneMapHdrToSdr` with decoupled scale-invariant OKLab gamut compression and highlight roll-off, luminance-coupled ITU-R BT.2100 HLG OOTF, proper 8-bit `BGRA8888`/`RGBA8888` unpremultiplication, and bitwise Inf/NaN sanitization. * Added **RGB JPEG Gain Map (`JCS_EXT_RGBA`)** & **ISO/TS 21496-1** support with SDR monitor ICC routing, `scRGB` detection for `.jxr`/`.wdp` in DecodeWorker, ACES AP0 matrices, and fixed JXL alpha double-premultiplication & LibRaw SDR HEIF mislabeling. --- ### 🐛 Stability, Security & UI Fixes * **Titan Huge-Image & Explorer COM Re-entrancy Crash (`0xc0000409`)**: Removed cross-process Explorer COM RPCs from mutex-held `ImageEngine` telemetry/prefetch paths and D2D `BeginDraw` loops, added STA COM re-entrancy protection, coalesced Explorer folder view queries per navigation step, and hardened `LODCache` high-bit-depth / >1 MB tile slab handling. * **>1 GB JXL 1×1 Fake Base Crash (`0xc0000005`)**: Separated true source dimensions (`Width`/`Height` metadata) from the 4-byte `1x1` placeholder buffer dimensions so downstream bilinear resizers never read out of bounds. * **[#303, #305, #308, GHSA-r5qf-q487-gwcq] Codec & Plugin Hardening**: Fixed heap OOB/overflows & inline/Big-Endian `SHORT` tags in `MiniTiff`, heap-allocated `LibRaw` to prevent stack overflow, resolved a `FreeLibrary` Use-After-Free in SR plugin parameter descriptors, fixed 32-bit float PSD transparency & guard leaks, and tightened Wuffs PNG allocation bounds. * **AI HTTP Transient Retry**: Added zero-dependency, `-fno-exceptions`-safe native WinHTTP retry logic for transient `408`/`429`/`5xx`/`529` responses (honoring `Retry-After` headers with immediate 50 ms cancellation checks). * **[#144, #269, #281, #283, #284, #310, #312] Window, UI & Localization**: Added Windows 10 accent borders, square corners & DPI/MSIX taskbar icon fixes; fixed strip-image window sizing & fullscreen/maximized `Auto` zoom; improved light-theme menu contrast, smooth gallery wheel scaling, localized rename/delete dialogs across all 8 languages, Russian translation fixes, and resolved CodeQL security alerts. --- ### ❤️ Special Thanks * **@cmixed** for Auto Pan (#309) * **@Dimmitrius** for Russian localization improvements (#310) * **@Mattbusel** for inspiring the AI HTTP retry improvements (#307) **Full
